title: Place
description: The service validator checks an event id, version 1, and a place with id, name, latitude, and longitude. A weather.forecast-updated event must carry a forecast with updatedAt, fetchedAt, mode, and one to six periods; each period is checked for a timestamp, numeric temperature, null or nonnegative numeric precipitation, and a string symbol. The weather_cards upsert stores place fields, updated_at, and the forecast JSON. The inbox table is used for event-id duplicate handling, while rejected_messages records topic, partition, offset, and reason. These shapes come from code checks and SQL statements, not a fully interpreted shared JSON Schema.
